reason: Provides remote browser and mobile access to the full DeepSeek Harness interface through a passcode-gated HTTP/WebSocket reverse proxy, with optional Cloudflare tunneling and access logging.

summaries.zh: 通过密码保护的反向代理和可选 Cloudflare 隧道，让手机或浏览器远程访问完整的 DeepSeek Harness 会话与控制界面。
summaries.en: Enables phone and browser access to the full DeepSeek Harness interface through a passcode-gated reverse proxy with optional Cloudflare tunneling.

capabilities: reverse-proxies the full harness interface over HTTP and WebSocket
exposes the interface through a Cloudflare quick tunnel or configured public host
authenticates browsers with a passcode and session cookies
forwards access to loopback-fenced harness methods including settings, credentials, tool approvals, and shell functions
